open_points.subject: create_budget_schema
open_points.text: Import from IMPORTS every symbol the module uses, including symbols used only in annotations, and annotate each parameter with the type its CONTRACTS signature declares, never object or nothing.
open_points.other_text: - create_budget_schema: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST keep the parameter annotation connection: object exactly as its contract declares; object is the declared type here, not a missing one: the transaction of the sqlite unit-of-work backend calls it with its open sqlite3 connection, which the function uses only through its cursor() method.
open_points.question: Must connection be annotated as object exactly as required by the contract and dependency-boundary note, or must object never be used as an annotation?
